title: How Many Goldfish Must Go? | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
A pond goes from 90% goldfish to 80% goldfish. Most kids guess 10, but the real answer is much bigger! Vantee shows how to watch the fish that never leave, a ratio shortcut, why each wrong answer is tempting, and a bigger pond to try yourself.
